text:
maria: Heads-up — pushed a set of new Grafana panels for continuous-batcher telemetry. Focus is on batch formation, queue-policy signals, token-budget targets, and KV cache interplay. Quick look before I flip the prod switch? https://grafana.internal/r/CIx1yz :eyes:

kevin: Link works. Can you paste the PromQL you're using for avg batch size and batch-util? Want to wire them to the cost dashboard as well.

maria: Sure — core queries I added: 
```
# avg tokens per batch over 5m
avg_over_time(
  (rate(runtime_batch_tokens_total[5m]) / rate(runtime_batch_count[5m]))[5m]
)

# batch utilization = filled_tokens / capacity_tokens (5m rate)
rate(runtime_batch_filled_tokens_total[5m]) / rate(runtime_batch_capacity_tokens_total[5m])

# tokens/sec served (global)
sum(rate(runtime_served_tokens_total[15s]))
```
These are grouped by `model` in the dashboard.

sasha: +1 on grouping by model. Also suggest a heatmap: x-axis = seq_len_bucket, y-axis = model, color = avg_batch_size. That exposes small-model, short-seq cases where batch size collapses.

thomas: FYI I saw a correlation last week: KV cache eviction spikes coincide with lower batch fill rate for small-seq traffic. We should surface `kv_cache_evictions_total` and `kv_cache_hit_rate` next to batch-util panel. Sample: 
```
kv_hit = sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) + rate(kv_cache_misses_total[5m]))
```
If hit rate drops < 0.6 we see fill rate drop ~20%.

jo: For alerts, recommend these defaults to start: 
- queue_depth_total > 250 for 2m -> P0 (backpressure/overload)
- avg_batch_size < 2.5 for 5m -> P2 (inefficient serving)
- batch_utilization < 0.35 for 10m -> P1 (wasted capacity)
- tokens/sec per-region drop >25% for 5m -> P1 (regional outage)
We'll tune thresholds after traffic A/B.

luis: Rollout plan: enable dashboard in read-only on prod for 12h, then enable alerts to staging for 24h, then canary alerts to 5% of infra. I'll gate by feature flag `batching.telemetry.v2`. Can we record an experiment metric `telemetry_checkin_ok` emitted by the agent when panels render? Need it for spike-free validation.

maria: Good plan. Also added a small tracing span `batch_formation.duration_ms` to help attribute latency regressions to queue policy vs kernel selection. Panel added.

deploy-bot: grafana: dashboard "Continuous Batcher — v2" updated by maria. Panels added: Batch Utilization heatmap, Queue Depth (per-region/model), Tokens/sec trend, KV cache hit/miss ratio, avg_batch_size timeseries.

kevin: One extra PromQL for tokens/sec per-model: 
```
sum by(model)(rate(runtime_served_tokens_total[15s]))
```
I'll wire that to the cost-per-token widget.

thomas: Action item — I'll add kv eviction tagging to the request logs so we can backtrace affected requests (owner: thomas).

sasha: I'll build the short-seq heatmap and an annotation layer for deploys so we don't chase rollout noise (owner: sasha).

jo: I'll create the initial alert rules and put them behind the `batching.telemetry.v2` flag so we can toggle.

luis: I'll run the canary and report SLO deltas after 24h (owner: luis).

maria: Thanks — summary of owners: thomas (kv tagging), sasha (heatmap + annotations), kevin (cost wiring), jo (alerts), luis (canary). I’ll flip read-only dashboard to prod tonight at 23:00 PT. Ping here when you start the canary. :thumbsup:
